# Image Asset — Futuristic Engineering Digital Twin

Original file: `a_wide_cinematic_futuristic_engineering_space_des.png`

Format in original package: PNG.

Description: A cinematic engineering workspace containing a detailed industrial process digital twin, engineering displays and human operators.

Presentation role: Represents the conversion of research evidence into engineered systems, simulations, interfaces and verification artifacts.

Restored Version 1 concept: The digital twin is a tool inside the harness, not proof by itself. Modeled or synthetic outputs remain distinct from physical empirical evidence and must pass validation, critique, review and verification gates.

Primary slide use: Hypatia Pro ISRU oxygen evidence-package case study.

Accessibility text: “Engineers reviewing a luminous digital twin of an industrial Mars processing system.”

September 2026 alignment: On slide 15, the image supports a verified MOXIE starting point. It is illustrative imagery, not a photograph of MOXIE and not evidence that the depicted plant exists. The NASA/JPL metrics establish feasibility; the digital twin represents the scale-up work still required.

## Version 5 use

Engineering/digital-twin imagery supports the controlled-baseline, structured-handoff, verification, and mission-memory sections. It represents workflow integration; numerical or physical claims must come from cited evidence and approved work products.
